svg.aria-label: 4 grids of 5 by 5 cells, coloured by temperature. Step 0: top row 100, the rest 0. Step 1: the 3 cells under the hot edge are 25. Step 2: those cells are 31.25, 37.50 and 31.25, and the row below is 6.25 in each cell. Step 200: the inner cells are 42.86, 52.68, 42.86 / 18.75, 25, 18.75 / 7.14, 9.82, 7.14.
svg.text: Jacobi iteration on the 5 x 5 grid
Each step replaces every inner cell by the mean of its old neighbours.
